_note: Job A batch 1, 30 August 2026. Most-told past-due claims. Reality only; base rates named wherever the outcome was likely regardless.

evidence.summary: The high-level general debate of the 80th UN General Assembly opened on 23 September 2025 with more than 150 heads of state and government speaking; Trump addressed it that day for 57 minutes. On 22 September France, Andorra, Belgium, Luxembourg, Malta and Monaco announced recognition of Palestinian statehood at a summit co-convened by France and Saudi Arabia, following the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and Portugal the day before.
evidence.rationale: He named the window from June 2025 onward, three months ahead, and the third week of September 2025 did carry an unusually consequential UN week: a coordinated wave of Palestinian statehood recognitions by close US allies, which is not an annual occurrence. That much could have failed and did not. Everything else is base rate or was supplied to him. The general debate opens in the fourth week of September every year and the 23 September 2025 date was published by the UN long in advance; his own telling on 19 August shows where the date came from, because he reads out a viewer letter pointing out that 23 and 24 September is the main UN event week. Rosh Hashanah likewise falls where the Hebrew calendar puts it. The distinctive content he added on top of the public calendar was that in a 24-hour period everything would change, and nothing answering to that description occurred on or about 23 September 2025. Held at partial.

evidence.summary: No event or measurement recorded in September or October 2025 corresponds to a point of no return. The UN high-level week he later ties it to, 23 September 2025, is a scheduled annual meeting. The fog on a calendar starting on the 5th, the red circle and the sandy haze have no stated referent in the world, and he supplies none in any later telling.
evidence.rationale: There is no criterion here that could have come out either way. A point of no return is asserted, not observed, and every later telling restates it rather than pointing at anything that happened. He is explicit about this himself on 23 October 2025: asked when, he says he does not know. The claim also has the structure that makes a miss impossible, because whatever follows the date is read as the acceleration the date was supposed to start. Recorded unfalsifiable rather than left unchecked. Note against him that the date he settles on, 23 September, is one he did not name until after a viewer wrote in with the UN calendar.

evidence.summary: Bethel Church in Redding, California placed Ben Armstrong, its overseer of prophetic ministry, on administrative leave on 15 February 2026 after a former Bethel School of Supernatural Ministry student publicly accused him of grooming and sexual assault in a podcast released 13 February 2026; a third-party investigation of Armstrong and of church culture followed. This sits in a continuing sequence that includes Gateway Church in Southlake, Texas, where founder Robert Morris resigned in June 2024 over child sexual abuse allegations.
evidence.rationale: One telling has a real lead. On 26 January 2026 he said a great shaking was coming to churches in California; Bethel Redding, a charismatic megachurch, suspended a named leader three weeks later. That is the only part of this thread with a date in front of the event. Against it: exposures of megachurch leadership have been close to continuous since 2024, California holds a large share of American megachurches, and a wave of exposures sets no count and no threshold, so the base rate over any three-week window is high. His 24 February telling, which names churches in California and mega ministers who would have to resign, comes nine days after the Bethel news broke and is not a prediction. The thread also re-dates itself repeatedly, running to the first of 2026, then 2026, then 2026 through 2029, then July to December, then July to 3 January, which removes any window that could expire.

evidence.summary: No event marks the opening or closing of a reprieve. The narrow branch he floated on 4 November 2024, that the window might run only until the first of the year, was not borne out: he continued teaching the four-year form through 2025 and into 2026, and on 29 July 2026 was still describing the window as running out to 2030.
evidence.rationale: A reprieve names no observable event in either direction. Its match condition is the absence of something, what would have been hell on earth, which is the null case, and its terminal date has moved from the first of 2025 to 2028 to 2029 to 2030 across the thread. The 2028 form is also not yet due. The one branch that carried a testable date, the 4 November 2024 suggestion that the window closed at the first of the year, is expressly hedged in the same breath: he says he has no idea whether that is what it means. Recorded unfalsifiable with the branch outcome noted rather than left unchecked.

evidence.summary: No measurable quantity is attached to the doubling of birthing pains from 1 April 2026, and no source can register it. The only concrete thing in the neighbourhood is the fireball record, and the American Meteor Society places the surge in the quarter before the date, with 2,322 events in Q1 2026 and March the standout month.
evidence.rationale: His own falsifier says it: birthing pains, by his definition, only increase, so no outcome can register as a miss. Acceleration by double names no quantity to double. The claim has also been serially re-dated inside itself, from April 1st, to May through September, to April 1st through 11 September, and then to a further doubling on 11 September 2026, so each passing window is absorbed into a longer one. Recorded unfalsifiable and stated as such rather than scored. Note for the priority question that his 5 June telling offers the Northeast events of late May and 1 June as proof, which is fulfilment assertion, not evidence, and belongs in that table.

evidence.summary: The 2025-2026 US influenza season was dominated by A(H3N2) subclade K, 92 percent of characterised H3N2 viruses collected since 28 September 2025. FluSurv-NET hospitalisations peaked in week 52, the week ending 27 December 2025, at 12.8 per 100,000, the second highest peak weekly rate since 2010-2011, with the highest paediatric peak weekly rate since 2010-2011. CDC's in-season severity assessment classified the season as moderate. No new pathogen emerged in the window.
evidence.rationale: He gave the shape on 28 January 2025, thirteen months ahead, and it is the shape that failed. He said the end of February, March, April and May would be the bulk, with June to August fading; the actual season peaked in late December and was already declining through February. CDC rated it moderate, not a plague. The undistinctive half, that a respiratory outbreak begins in autumn, has a base rate of one, because that is the definition of a flu season in the northern hemisphere. Note also that he vacated this window himself before it closed: from 12 November 2025 he re-dates the plague to November and December of 2027 or 2028, so on his own account the thing has not happened yet.

evidence.summary: 2 October 2023 was an ordinary news day: 29 soldiers killed in an ambush in the Tahoua region of Niger, Turkish airstrikes on PKK targets in northern Iraq, an oil refinery explosion in Rivers State, Nigeria, and a UN Security Council resolution authorising a Kenyan-led force for Haiti. Nothing on the day answers to a great judgment. The Hamas attack on Israel came five days later, on 7 October 2023.
evidence.rationale: The date was named and it passed with nothing. Two things about how he handled it matter more than the miss. First, he removed his own falsifier in advance: in the same 1 July 2023 telling that gives the count, he says the Lord told him the timeframe was extended and pushed back for more repentance, so the date could no longer fail before it arrived. Second, on 7 May 2024 he says that if his arithmetic on the 569 days was off, the thing still happened inside the window the angel gave, which is a retroactive fit to 7 October. The count itself is unstable within one sitting, given as 569 days and then as 510 days landing on the same date. Scored on the date he named, in advance, in public.

evidence.summary: Gallup records US church attendance continuing to fall through 2024, to about 28 percent attending regularly, down from 48 percent in 2009. Lifeway found that in 2024 an estimated 4,000 Protestant churches closed against 3,800 opened, the first year in its tracking history in which closures outpaced openings. The Barna figures showing a young-adult uptick date from 2025, after the year in question.
evidence.rationale: The stated test was a year of visible flourishing for the church, and the measurable church indicators moved the other way in 2024: attendance at a series low and, for the first time on record, more Protestant congregations closing than opening. Two things temper this without rescuing it. The economic half of the same 12 August 2023 telling landed, because he said the economy would be pumped full of money to make everything look good going into 2024, and the S&P 500 returned about 24 percent on a deficit near 5.6 percent of GDP. And on 5 February 2024 he made the year good only for the hearer who believes, which converts a public claim into a private one. The unconditional forms stand: on 28 November 2024 he told viewers 2024 would be the best year they had lived so far.

evidence.summary: 2024 in the United States: S&P 500 up about 24 percent, GDP growth near 3 percent, inflation around 3 percent, unemployment 4.1 percent, and a federal deficit of about 5.6 percent of GDP. Church attendance and congregation counts fell over the same year.
evidence.rationale: He supplies the reason himself: a coin with two sides, which you may read either way, and a year that is good even though bad things also happen. There is no threshold, no domain and no measurement, so both the good and the bad readings are available in every year, and on 5 February 2024 he makes the outcome depend on whether the hearer believes and is grateful. Recorded unfalsifiable and said so, rather than counted as a hit off the market numbers, which is what a loose reading would do. The separate claim that the church would soar is scoreable, and is scored against under soar-2024.

evidence.summary: The American Meteor Society logged 2,322 fireball events in Q1 2026, the highest on record, with 40 events over 50 witness reports against a norm near 20, and five March events exceeding 200 reports, more than all prior Marches combined since 2011. AMS concludes something appears to have shifted. The named events cluster before April: a daylight fireball with a sonic boom over Ohio and Pennsylvania on 17 March, and a fireball over Pennsylvania, North Carolina, Ohio, Virginia and West Virginia on 26 March. After 1 April: a daylight fireball over five northeastern states on 7 April with more than 200 reports, G2 geomagnetic storm watches for 3-4 and 17-18 April, and two X-class flares from AR4419 on 24 April.
evidence.rationale: Notable fireball activity and solar storms did continue after 1 April 2026, which is what he said would happen, and the 7 April daylight fireball and the 24 April X-class flares are real instances. What holds this well short of a hit is priority and base rate together. The surge is a Q1 phenomenon on the AMS numbers, peaking in March, and he gave the word on 27 March, ten days after the 17 March Ohio and Pennsylvania daylight fireball made national news and one day after the 26 March Pennsylvania and North Carolina event. The Pennsylvania and North Carolina boom he offers as proof on 2 June matches the 26 March event, which is before the window he set. His own falsifier concedes the rest: meteors enter the atmosphere continuously and solar maximum produces X-class flares regularly, so signs in the heavens in any given month is close to certain.

evidence.summary: Gold rose from about 2,623 to about 4,339 dollars an ounce across 2025, roughly 65 percent, set a record above 5,600 dollars in January 2026, declined from March 2026, and rose again about 16 percent during August 2026 to about 4,600 dollars, on a weaker dollar and concern over US debt. More than ten records were set in the year, with autumn 2025 and the first quarter of 2026 the spikes.
evidence.rationale: The single element with a public price series behaved as described. On 7 November 2025 he called it a short-lived wave with gold on it, and gold went on to a record in January 2026 and then turned over in March, which is a wave and is short-lived. Two heavy discounts. Gold had already risen about 65 percent during 2025 and was setting records through the autumn when he spoke, so the trend was the most conspicuous trade in the market before the word rather than after it. And the rest of the claim cannot fail by construction: no recipients, no amounts, no dates, with metals and cryptos and foreign currencies all left unnamed, and on 8 August 2026 he adds that the transfer must be contended for rather than received, which shifts any shortfall onto the hearer. The June 2026 form, a trickle starting by the 14th, sets the smallest threshold available and needs no evidence to satisfy.
